DD_Attribute.name: object_name
DD_Attribute.definition: Specific name of the celestial body (whether it is the target of observation or not)

DD_Attribute.name: parent_body
DD_Attribute.definition: For moons/satellites, specifies the parent planet or body.

DD_Attribute.name: scope
DD_Attribute.definition: The scope of the data collection.

DD_Permissible_Value.value_meaning: Data collected from the entire object
Data collected from a large region of the object
Data collected from a small location on the object
Any scope not covered by other values

DD_Attribute.name: primary_field
DD_Attribute.definition: Primary scientific field of study.

DD_Permissible_Value.value_meaning: Study of life in the universe
Geophysics of the Earth and other planets
Seismology of the Earth and other planets
Surface studies of the Earth and other planets
Crater counting of the Earth and other planets
Interior studies of the Earth and other planets
Dynamics of the Earth and other planets
Atmospheric studies of the Earth and other planets
Modeling of the Earth and other planets
Magnetospheres of the Earth and other planets
Space physics of the Earth and other planets
Any field not covered by other values

DD_Attribute.name: investigation_technique
DD_Attribute.definition: Method of scientific investigation used.

DD_Permissible_Value.value_meaning: Collection of scanning electron microscopy data
Collection of transmission electron microscopy data
Collection of inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometry data
Any investigation technique not covered by other values

DD_Attribute.name: study_focus
DD_Attribute.definition: Primary focus area of the scientific study.

DD_Permissible_Value.value_meaning: Study focused on surface features or properties
Study focused on internal structure or processes
Study focused on atmospheric properties or dynamics
Study focused on magnetic field properties or interactions
Study focused on orbital properties or behaviors
Study focused on chemical or mineral composition
Any focus not covered by other values

DD_Attribute.name: collection_method
DD_Attribute.definition: Method used to collect the data.

DD_Permissible_Value.value_meaning: Data collected by an orbiting spacecraft
Data collected by a surface lander
Data collected by a mobile surface rover
Data collected by Earth-based or space telescopes
Any collection method not covered by other values

DD_Attribute.name: instrument_type
DD_Attribute.definition: Type of instrument used to collect the data.

DD_Permissible_Value.value_meaning: Any instrument type not covered by other values

DD_Attribute.name: data_category
DD_Attribute.definition: General category of the collected data.

DD_Permissible_Value.value_meaning: Flat rendering of existing data base
Any data type not covered by other values

DD_Attribute.name: data_format
DD_Attribute.definition: Format of the collected data.

DD_Permissible_Value.value_meaning: A 3D model of the surface of the object
A map of the geologic features of the object
A map of the thermal properties of the object
A composite image of the object
A map of the spectral properties of the object
A list of craters on the object
A list of light curves on the object
A list of spectra on the object
A list of physical properties of the object
A list of photometric properties of the object
A map of the gravity of the object
A list of taxonomies of the object
A list of irregular crater types on the object

DD_Attribute.name: temporal_epoch
DD_Attribute.definition: The temporal epoch of the data collection.

DD_Permissible_Value.value_meaning: Any temporal epoch not covered by other values

DD_Attribute.name: material_type
DD_Attribute.definition: Physical type of material being studied.

DD_Permissible_Value.value_meaning: Any material type not covered by other values

DD_Attribute.name: feature_type
DD_Attribute.definition: Type of geological or physical feature being studied.

DD_Permissible_Value.value_meaning: Any feature type not covered by other values

DD_Attribute.name: process_type
DD_Attribute.definition: Type of process being studied.

DD_Permissible_Value.value_meaning: Any process type not covered by other values

DD_Attribute.name: composition
DD_Attribute.definition: Primary composition of the material being studied.

DD_Permissible_Value.value_meaning: Composed primarily of water or other volatile ices
Composed of a mixture of different materials
Any composition not covered by other values

DD_Attribute.name: temperature_regime
DD_Attribute.definition: Temperature conditions at the study location.

DD_Permissible_Value.value_meaning: Moderate temperatures, similar to Earth temperate regions
Very high temperatures like Venus surface
Any temperature regime not covered by other values

DD_Attribute.name: pressure_conditions
DD_Attribute.definition: Pressure conditions at the study location.

DD_Permissible_Value.value_meaning: Very high pressure like Venus surface or gas giant interiors
Any pressure condition not covered by other values

DD_Attribute.name: radiation_environment
DD_Attribute.definition: Radiation conditions at the study location.

DD_Permissible_Value.value_meaning: Minimal radiation exposure like Earth surface
Similar to Earth orbit or Mars surface
Significant radiation like Jupiter radiation belts
Protected or shielded from external radiation
Any radiation environment not covered by other values

DD_Attribute.name: atmospheric_presence
DD_Attribute.definition: Presence and nature of atmosphere at the study location.

DD_Permissible_Value.value_meaning: Minimal atmosphere like Mercury or Moon
Dense atmosphere like Venus or Titan
Massive, deep atmosphere of a gas giant
Any atmospheric presence not covered by other values

DD_Attribute.name: analysis_method
DD_Attribute.definition: Primary method used to analyze the data.

DD_Permissible_Value.value_meaning: Machine learning or AI based analysis
Any analysis method not covered by other values

DD_Attribute.name: software_used
DD_Attribute.definition: Primary software tools used for data analysis.

DD_Attribute.name: processing_steps
DD_Attribute.definition: Description of processing steps applied to the data.

DD_Attribute.name: uncertainty_measurements
DD_Attribute.definition: Description of uncertainty or error measurements associated with the data.

DD_Attribute.name: quality_indicators
DD_Attribute.definition: Indicators of data quality or reliability.

DD_Permissible_Value.value_meaning: High quality data with minimal errors
Medium quality data with some uncertainties
Lower quality data with significant uncertainties
Quality has not been formally assessed
Quality indicator not covered by other values

DD_Attribute.name: research_goals
DD_Attribute.definition: Primary research goals or objectives of the study.

DD_Attribute.name: related_publications
DD_Attribute.definition: Publications related to or derived from the data.

DD_Attribute.name: keywords
DD_Attribute.definition: Keywords that describe the data and research focus.

DD_Attribute.name: principal_investigator
DD_Attribute.definition: Name of the principal investigator or lead researcher.

DD_Attribute.name: institution
DD_Attribute.definition: Institution or organization associated with the research.

DD_Attribute.name: feature_name
DD_Attribute.definition: Name of the feature being studied.

DD_Attribute.name: asteroid_type
DD_Attribute.definition: Type of asteroid.

DD_Permissible_Value.value_meaning: Asteroids with orbits that bring them close to Earth
Asteroids that share an orbit with a planet
Asteroids in the main asteroid belt
Any asteroid type not covered by other values

DD_Permissible_Value.value_meaning: Objects in the classical Kuiper belt

Any TNO type not covered by other values

DD_Attribute.name: centaur_type
DD_Attribute.definition: Type of centaur object.

DD_Permissible_Value.value_meaning: Any centaur type not covered by other values

DD_Attribute.name: kbo_type
DD_Attribute.definition: Type of Kuiper belt object.

DD_Permissible_Value.value_meaning: Objects in the classical Kuiper belt
Objects in orbital resonance with Neptune
Any KBO type not covered by other values

DD_Attribute.name: oort_cloud_type
DD_Attribute.definition: Type of Oort cloud object.

DD_Permissible_Value.value_meaning: Objects in the inner Oort cloud
Objects in the outer Oort cloud
Any Oort cloud object type not covered by other values

DD_Attribute.name: comet_type
DD_Attribute.definition: Type of comet.

DD_Permissible_Value.value_meaning: Comets that pass through the solar system once
Any comet type not covered by other values

DD_Attribute.name: satellite_type
DD_Attribute.definition: Type of natural satellite.

DD_Permissible_Value.value_meaning: The four largest moons of Jupiter
Any satellite type not covered by other values

DD_Attribute.name: planet_type
DD_Attribute.definition: Type of planet.

DD_Permissible_Value.value_meaning: Large planets composed mainly of gas
Planets closer to the Sun than Earth
Any planet type not covered by other values

DD_Attribute.name: atmospheric_layer
DD_Attribute.definition: Layer of the atmosphere.

DD_Permissible_Value.value_meaning: Any atmospheric layer not covered by other values

DD_Attribute.name: field_type
DD_Attribute.definition: Type of field or radiation.

DD_Permissible_Value.value_meaning: Any field type not covered by other values

DD_Attribute.name: dust_type
DD_Attribute.definition: Type of dust or meteoroid.

DD_Permissible_Value.value_meaning: Any dust type not covered by other values

DD_Attribute.name: ring_section
DD_Attribute.definition: Section of a planetary ring.

DD_Permissible_Value.value_meaning: Any ring section not covered by other values

DD_Attribute.name: ring_division
DD_Attribute.definition: Division between ring sections.

DD_Permissible_Value.value_meaning: Division between A and B rings
Any ring division not covered by other values

DD_Attribute.name: ring_feature
DD_Attribute.definition: Feature within a planetary ring.

DD_Permissible_Value.value_meaning: Any ring feature not covered by other values

DD_Attribute.name: solar_component
DD_Attribute.definition: Component of the Sun.

DD_Permissible_Value.value_meaning: Region of space dominated by the Sun
Region where energy is transferred by radiation
Region where energy is transferred by convection
Outermost layer of the Sun's atmosphere
Stream of charged particles from the Sun
Any solar component not covered by other values
